data.one_liner: A Flutter paginator widget for switching between page numbers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable pagination widget that allows users to switch between page numbers in a Flutter application. It automatically handles large page counts by replacing overflow numbers with dots, and supports numbers, scrollable numbers, dropdowns, and custom layouts.
use_when: You need to display pagination numbers for long lists or multi-page views.
You want customizable pagination controls with support for prev/next buttons and controllers.
avoid_when: You require infinite scrolling instead of explicit page number navigation.
strengths: Easy to set up with minimal required properties.
Flexible layout options including numbers, scrollable numbers, dropdowns, and custom builders.
Includes an external controller for programmatic navigation.
weaknesses: Recent major version updates introduced breaking changes regarding UI configuration and default arrow visibility.
